study: pentane R15 timestep / FR campaign (docs/PENTANE_R15_DT_FR.md), Stage A: integrator validation
frozen_utc: 2026-10-18, before any Stage A dynamics was run
integrator: production overdamped Euler-Maruyama, q <- remove_com(q + dt (F_clip + b) + sqrt(2 dt / beta) xi) (core_dist.run_sampler_dist, verbatim)
dt_extension: 6.25e-5 only if none of the three is ADMISSIBLE

ensembles.A1_gibbs: 8 groups x 1024 walkers drawn exactly from the pentane Gibbs law (internal-coordinate proposal, weight exp(-beta V_nb), weighted reservoir from a 20M pool); unbiased production EM; no walls
ensembles.A2_flat: 8 groups x 1024 walkers drawn exactly from the window-restricted Gibbs law with a flat R marginal over the 162 window bins (per-bin weighted reservoir from a 200M pool); production EM under the FIXED bias force +F'_ref(R) grad R on the window (edge value held constant outside it) plus the production soft walls (1.45, 3.65, k 200). VALIDATION ONLY: the reference enters this integrator test as a fixed flattening bias; it never enters ABF or FR.

run_length: T_A = 10 time units per group; deposits from t = 0.25 (fast bond/bend relaxation to the integrator's own law) to t = 10, every step
clip_control: each (ensemble, dt) is run twice on identical initial states and noise: production clip 200 and unclipped (clip 0)

statistics.F_mean_force_route: per group: binned conditional mean of the production local mean force (window bins), trapezoid-integrated, centred on the window
statistics.F_density_route_A2: per group: F = -beta^-1 log p(R) + F_ref(R) (bias potential = -F_ref) on the window, centred
statistics.F_density_route_A1: per group: F = -beta^-1 log p(R) on the window bins with F_ref - min(F_ref) <= 2.5 (5 kT), centred on that sub-window
statistics.D: debiased windowed RMS of (group-mean profile - F_ref): D^2 = mean_bins(dbar^2) - mean_bins(s_b^2 / G) - mean_bins(var_ref_b); D = sqrt(max(D^2, 0)); upper bound U95 = 95th percentile of D over 2000 bootstrap resamples of the 8 groups

gate.tau_justification: 0.10 energy units = 0.2 kT. (i) above the reference's own route disagreement (0.042) and its F' SE (0.04), so it is resolvable; (ii) ABF's windowed L2 error at T = 40 on this cell is 1.0-1.4 (v2), so a residual shared discretisation bias of 0.10 is <= 10 % of the quantity whose 10 % change the ABF-FR comparison seeks to resolve, and it enters both arms identically
gate.ADMISSIBLE: A2 flat ensemble, production clip: U95(D_MF) <= 0.10 AND U95(D_density) <= 0.10; AND clip immaterial; AND zero non-finite walkers
gate.MARGINAL: point estimates <= 0.10 but an upper bound > 0.10 (precision-limited: extend groups before deciding)
gate.FAIL: either point estimate > 0.10, or any non-finite walker
gate.clip_immaterial: fraction of clipped per-atom force evaluations <= 1e-5 AND debiased RMS between the clipped and unclipped mean-force-route profiles (paired runs) <= 0.05
gate.selection_rule: the LARGEST ADMISSIBLE dt of the ladder (cheapest valid). Chosen from Stage A numerics only, never from any ABF or FR outcome. If none is ADMISSIBLE after the 6.25e-5 extension, no timestep is validated and all later comparisons are labelled exploratory.

reported_not_gated: F' bias RMS per dt (mean-force route)
bond-length mean / variance and bend TV vs exact Gibbs
torsional-family populations through time vs exact (A1)
